<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/about-workplace-reports","lastmod":"2025-09-05T01:22Z","nid":"1517826"} -->
## About Workplace Reports

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-workplace-reports
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Analytics > About Workplace Reports
- Last modified: 2025-09-05T01:22Z
- Summary: Information on the Workplace Reports page in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

You can schedule attendance reports for your users or workplaces for regular distribution to specified recipients. For example, you can schedule the monthly attendance report of your IT department in San Jose. The scheduled reports are emailed as links to the recipients.

Workplace reports provide the following benefits and enable you to:

- Schedule reports for various criteria and distribute them to your choice of email recipients.
- Frequently generate attendance reports organized based on users or workplaces.

## About the Workplace Reports Page

On the Workplace Reports page (Analytics > Reports > Workplace Reports), you can do the following:

1. [Add a scheduled report](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/scheduling-workplace-reports).
2. View a list of all configured scheduled reports. For each report, you can view:
  - **Report Name:** The name of the scheduled report.
  - **Summary:** A brief summary of the report. This is autogenerated based on the scheduled report.
  - **Next Run**: The date when the next report is scheduled to be generated.
3. [Modify the table and its columns](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/using-tables-business-insights).
4. [Enable or disable the scheduled report](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/enabling-or-disabling-scheduled-reports).
5. [Edit a scheduled report](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/editing-or-deleting-items-business-insights).
6. Download the report.
7. [Delete a scheduled report](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/editing-or-deleting-items-business-insights).

[Image: The Workplace Reports page showing the list of scheduled reports]
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

---

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/about-workplace-tags","lastmod":"2025-06-12T23:41Z","nid":"1510601"} -->
## About Workplace Tags

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-workplace-tags
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Workplace Insights > Workplace Settings > About Workplace Tags
- Last modified: 2025-06-12T23:41Z
- Summary: Information on workplace tags and how to use them in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

The Workplace Tags feature can be used for linking workplaces to user-defined tags. These tags are then leveraged as a filtering option in viewing workplace insights. Admins can create tag categories as necessary and add multiple tags to them. You can add a maximum of 8 tag categories, and each category can consist of 8 tags. For example, you can create a tag category called Region and add tags that indicate the region of the workplace, like Europe, America, Asia, etc. This helps to filter workplace insights for specific regions when required in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

You can choose to tag workplaces using dynamic or manual tagging. With dynamic tagging, you can configure criteria based on which workplaces are automatically linked to a tag, or use manual tagging to individually select the workplaces that you want to link to a tag.

Tags provide the following benefits and allow you to:

- Link various tags to workplaces as per your organization's requirements.
- Filter and view workplace insights based on user-defined tags.
- Provide the flexibility to tag multiple workplaces based on the configured criteria with dynamic tagging.

## About the Workplace Tags Page

On the Tag Management page (Workplaces > Offices and Locations > Offices > click the drop-down menu under the Tags column for any office > Manage All Tags, or click the Tags filter > Manage All Tags), you can do the following:

1. [Add a new tag category](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/adding-tag-category).
2. View a list of configured tag categories. For each category, you can view:
  - **Tag Category**: The name of the category.
  - **Tags**: The tags added to the category.
  - **Offices**: The number of workplaces linked to the tag category. Click the number to be redirected to the [Offices](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-configured-offices) page listing offices linked to the tag category.
  - **Type**: The type of tagging (i.e., **Dynamic** or **Manual**).
3. [Modify the table columns](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/using-tables-business-insights).
4. [Edit a tag category](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/editing-or-deleting-items-business-insights).

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/about-zia-users","lastmod":"2024-12-09T06:06Z","nid":"1508371"} -->
## About ZIA Users

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-zia-users
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Authentication & Administration > About ZIA Users
- Last modified: 2024-12-09T06:06Z
- Summary: About ZIA users in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

The ZIA Users page show the user data synced from your Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) tenant. Any user configuration or changes that you make on the [User Management](https://help.zscaler.com/zia/authentication-administration/provisioning-authenticating-users/user-management) pages in the ZIA Admin Portal are synced to this page.

The ZIA Users page provides the following benefits and allows you to:

- View the users added to your ZIA tenant.
- View the list of users that are computed for Business Insights.

## About the ZIA Users Page

On the ZIA Users page (Administration > ZIA Users > ZIA Users), you can do the following:

1. Search for a user by User ID or Name, Group, or Department.
2. View a list of configured users. For each user, you can view:
  - **User ID or Name**: The user's username or domain name.
  - **User Name**: The user's display name.
  - **Groups**: The groups the user belongs to.
  - **Department**: The department the user belongs to.
  - **Status**: The status of the user (**Enabled**or **Disabled**).
  - **Comments**: The comments regarding the user, if available.
3. [Modify the table and its columns](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/using-tables-business-insights).
4. Go to the [Departments](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-departments)page.

[Image: ZIA Users Tab]
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/accessing-and-navigating-business-insights-admin-portal","lastmod":"2025-02-07T06:36Z","nid":"1473091"} -->
## Accessing and Navigating the Business Insights Admin Portal

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/accessing-and-navigating-business-insights-admin-portal
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Getting Started > Admin Portal > Accessing and Navigating the Business Insights Admin Portal
- Last modified: 2025-02-07T06:36Z
- Summary: Information on the Business Insights Admin Portal, including how to sign in to and navigate the portal.

This article covers the following topics:

- Accessing the Business Insights Admin Portal
- Accepting the End User Subscription Agreement (EUSA)
- Navigating within the Business Insights Admin Portal

Zscaler Support configures a super admin role, which has access to all the functions in the Business Insights Admin Portal, and emails you requesting the password to be set for that role. After you set the password, take note of your login ID used for accessing the [Business Insights Admin Portal](https://admin.zscaleranalytics.net/).

When the Sign In page appears:

1. Enter your**Login ID** and select the **Remember my Login ID** checkbox if you want the service to remember your username the next time you log in. See image.
2. Click **Next**.
3. Select the Zscaler cloud from the **Select Cloud App Tenant** drop-down menu.
4. Based on whether the Authentication Service service is enabled for the account or not, one of the following authentication flows appears:
  - For Authentication Service-Enabled Account
  - For Account Without Authentication Service

## With Authentication Service

If you're subscribed to Authentication Service:

1. Log in to the Authentication Service Landing Page.
2. Click the **Business Insights** tile to access the Business Insights Admin Portal. If you have multiple tenants provisioned to the Business Insights service, click on the Business Insights service access tile for the tenant that you want to access.

See image.

You are redirected to the Business Insights Admin Portal.

When you log in for the first time, the Business Insights Admin Portal displays a EUSA. Click **Accept** to accept the EUSA.

If you don't accept EUSA, the service logs you out of the Business Insights Admin Portal.

[Image: EUSA for Business Insights Admin Portal]

You can read the full EUSA at [https://www.zscaler.com/legal/end-user-subscription-agreement](https://www.zscaler.com/legal/end-user-subscription-agreement).

The Business Insights Admin Portal has the following items in the left-side navigation:

- Search
- Applications
- Workspace
- Reports
- Administration
- Notifications
- Account
- Help
- Log Out

Use the arrow at the bottom to show or hide the left-side navigation.

Search for an item in the left-side navigation.

Click **Application**to view application insights for discovered, connected, and overlapping apps, as well as their cost-saving opportunities. To learn more, see:

- [About Application Insights](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-application-inventory)
- [About All Applications](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-all-applications)
- [About Application Configuration](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-application-configuration)

Click **Workplace** to view insights and monitor your workplace. To learn more, see:

- [Analyzing Workplace Insights](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/analyzing-workplace-insights)
- [About Offices and Locations](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-offices-and-locations)
- [About Department Mapping](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-department-mapping)
- [About Configured Offices](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-configured-offices)

Click **Reports**to download your Business Insights analysis report or schedule a report. To learn more, see:

- [Downloading Business Insights Reports](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/downloading-business-insights-reports).
- [About Scheduled Reports](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-scheduled-reports)

Click **Administration**to manage your admins, their roles, view user accounts, and audit logs. To learn more, see:

- [Understanding Administrator Management Settings](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/understanding-administrator-management-settings-business-insights)
- [About Role Management](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-role-management-business-insights)
- [About Audit Logs](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-audit-logs-business-insights)
- [Integrating a SaaS Application for Workflow Automation](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/integrating-saas-application-workflow-automation)

Click **Notifications** to view any new notifications within the Business Insights Admin Portal.

Click **Account** to view your username, cloud name, and organization ID. You can also change your password on this page. To learn more, see [Managing Your Admin Account](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/managing-your-admin-account).

Click **Help** to enable remote assistance for your Business Insights Admin Portal. To learn more, see [Enabling Remote Assistance](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/enabling-remote-assistance-business-insights).

Click **Logout** to log out of the Business Insights Admin Portal when you are done.

The Zscaler service redirects you to the Authentication Service authentication page.

Based on your organization's authentication preference, sign in to the Authentication Service service using one of the following methods:

- Password
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
- Email One-Time Password (OTP)
- Security Key or Biometric

After a successful authentication by the Authentication Service service, you're redirected to the Business Insights Admin Portal.

Enter your **Password**and click **Sign In**. If you forget your password, click **Having trouble signing in?**> **Reset Password**, and a reset email is sent to your email ID. The password reset link within the email expires after 5 minutes. To learn more, see [Resetting the Password or MFA](https://help.zscaler.com/zidentity/1.0/resetting-login-credentials-mfa).

1. Enter your **Password**and click **Sign In**.
2. Based on your organization's MFA policy, two-factor authentication (2FA) is required. Complete your 2FA to access the Authentication Service Landing Page.

If you forget your password or want to configure a different secondary authenticator, click **Having trouble signing in?**> **Reset Password**or**Reset Second Factor**, and a reset email is sent to your email ID. The reset link within the email expires after 5 minutes. To learn more, see [Resetting the Password or MFA](https://help.zscaler.com/zidentity/1.0/resetting-login-credentials-mfa).

If your account is configured with MFA, you can sign in using a email OTP as well:

1. Click **Email OTP**.
2. Enter the OTP received to your email address and click **Sign In**. The OTP expires after two minutes. If the OTP expires or you don't receive an OTP, click **Resend**to receive another OTP after 60 seconds.

1. Select **Sign-in using Security Key or Biometric**.
2. Click**Next**.
3. Based on your configuration, enter your security key or complete the biometric to access the Authentication Service Landing Page.

If you want to configure with a different security key or biometric, click **Having trouble signing in?**> **Reset Security Key or Biometric**, and a reset email is sent to your email ID. The reset link within the email expires after 5 minutes. To learn more, see [Resetting the Password or MFA](https://help.zscaler.com/zidentity/1.0/resetting-login-credentials-mfa).

The Password page appears.

1. In the **Password**field, enter your Business Insights Admin Portal password.
2. Click **Sign In**. Click **Back**if you want to go back to the Sign In page.

After a successful authentication by the Business Insights service, you're logged in to the Business Insights Admin Portal.

Based on your organization's [authentication preference](https://help.zscaler.com/authentication-service/configuring-multi-factor-authentication), sign in to Authentication Service using one of the following methods:

- Password
- Email One-Time Password (OTP)
- Security Key or Biometric

1. Enter your **Login ID**. If you want the service to remember your login ID the next time you log in, select **Remember Me**. See image.
2. Click**Next**.
3. Enter your **Password**and click **Sign In**. See image.
4. Based on your organization's multi-factor authentication policy, two-factor authentication (2FA) is required. Complete your 2FA to access the Authentication Service landing page. If you forget your password or want to configure a different secondary authenticator, click **Having trouble signing in?**> **Reset Password**or**Reset Second Factor**, and a reset email is sent to your email ID. The reset link within the email expires after 15 minutes. To learn more, see [Resetting the Login Credentials or MFA](https://help.zscaler.com/unified/resetting-login-credentials-or-mfa).

If your account is configured with MFA, you can sign in using an email OTP:

1. Enter your **Login ID**. If you want the service to remember your login ID the next time you log in, select **Remember Me**.
2. Click**Next** and then click **Other Sign-in Options**. See image. The **Sign-in Options** window appears.
3. In the **Sign-in Options** window, click **Email OTP**. See image.
4. Enter the OTP sent to your email address and click **Sign In**. The OTP expires after 15 minutes. If the OTP expires or you don't receive an OTP, click **Resend**to receive another OTP after 60 seconds. See image.

1. Enter your **Login ID**. If you want the service to remember your login ID the next time you log in, select **Remember Me**.
2. Select **Sign-in using Security Key or Biometric**. See image.
3. Click**Next**.
4. Based on your configuration, enter your security key or complete the biometric to access the Authentication Service landing page. If you want to configure with a different security key or biometric, click **Having trouble signing in?**> **Reset Security Key or Biometric**, and a reset email is sent to your email ID. The reset link within the email expires after 15 minutes. To learn more, see [Resetting the Login Credentials or MFA](https://help.zscaler.com/unified/resetting-login-credentials-or-mfa).

[Image: Authentication Service login page with blurred Login ID and Remember Me option selected.]

[Image: A screenshot with blurred login ID and displaying password field.]

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/adding-admin-roles-business-insights","lastmod":"2025-02-13T22:58Z","nid":"1473166"} -->
## Adding Admin Roles in Business Insights

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/adding-admin-roles-business-insights
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Authentication & Administration > Administrator and Role Management > Adding Admin Roles in Business Insights
- Last modified: 2025-02-13T22:58Z
- Summary: How to add administrator roles in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

Roles dictate the level of access admins have to a feature or module in the Business Insights Admin Portal. Configuring the Business Insights admin role is one of the tasks you must complete when configuring role-based administration. To learn more, see [Configuring Role-Based Administration](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-role-based-administration-business-insights).

## Prerequisites

Before you can configure roles, ensure the following prerequisites are met:

- You must have the proper permissions to configure a role.
- You must have organizational scope.

## Adding Admin Roles

To configure admin roles:

1. Go to **Administration**>**Role Management**.
2. Click **Add Role**.

The **Add Role** drawer appears.

1. In the **Add Role** drawer:
  - **Name**: Enter a namefor the admin role.
  - **Permissions**: Permissions allow you to control an admin's access to the major features in the Business Insights Admin Portal. Depending on the feature, you must select one of the following permissions: For each role you configure, you must assign permissions in the following categories: See image.
    - **Full**: Allows admins to view, add, edit, and delete items.
    - **View Only**: Allows admin view-only access to the feature.
    - **None**: Doesn’t allow admins access to the feature.
    - **Visible**: Allows admin to view specific data in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
    - **Obfuscated**: Specific data is obfuscated in the Business Insights Admin Portal for the admin.
    - General Permissions
    - Module Permissions
    - Feature Permissions
    - Data Visibility
2. Click **Save** You can [edit or delete](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/editing-or-deleting-items-business-insights) admin roles at any time.

For **General Permissions**, admins can manage other admins, view Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) users and locations, or enable remote assistance in:

- Administrator Management (Administration > Administration Management)
- Remote Assistance Management (Help > Remote Assistance)
- ZIA User Management (Administration > ZIA Users)
- ZIA Location Management (Administration > ZIA Locations)

For **Module Permissions**, admins can view and manage the following Business Insights modules:

- Application Insights (Applications > Application Insights)
- All Applications (Applications > All Applications)
- Application Settings (Applications > Application Settings)
- Workplaces (all the modules inside the Workplaces section)
- All Contracts (Applications > All Contracts)

For **Feature Permissions**, admins can configure scheduled reports and set up Workflow Automation, or view system-generated reports under the Reports section.

The **Data Visibility**permission allows you to view or obfuscate the usernames throughout the Business Insights Admin Portal for the role.

[Image: Create Role Drawer]
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

---

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/adding-admins-business-insights","lastmod":"2025-01-10T05:17Z","nid":"1473176"} -->
## Adding Admins in Business Insights

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/adding-admins-business-insights
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Authentication & Administration > Administrator and Role Management > Adding Admins in Business Insights
- Last modified: 2025-01-10T05:17Z
- Summary: Information on how to add administrators in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

This article describes how to add admins for the Business Insights Admin Portal.

To add an admin:

1. Go to **Administration**> **Administrators**.
2. Click **Add Admin**.

The **Add Administrator** drawer appears.

1. In the **Add Administrator** drawer:

- **Login ID**: Enter the login ID the admin uses to log in and select the appropriate domain name. The domain names you provided to Zscaler appear in the drop-down menu.
- **Email**: Enter the admin's email address.
- **Name**: Enter a name for the admin.
- **Role**: Choose a role to specify the admin's level of access to the Business Insights Admin Portal. To configure a new role, see [Adding Admin Roles](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/adding-admin-roles-business-insights).
- **Scope**: Choose the admin scope to specify which areas of the organization the admin can manage in the Business Insights Admin Portal:
  - **Organization**: Provides the ability to manage all areas in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
  - **Offices**: Select admin scope over specific configured offices.
  - **Office Geolocations**: Select admin scope over configured offices based on the geography (i.e., city, state, country, etc.).
- **Comments**: (Optional) Enter additional notes or information. The comments cannot exceed 10,240 characters.
- **Set Password**: Enable **Password Based Login** if you want the admins to authenticate using a password.
  - **Password**: Enter a password for the admin. It can be 8 to 100 characters and must contain at least one number, one special character, and one uppercase letter.
  - **Confirm Password**: Re-enter the password to confirm.

See image.

1. Click **Save**. The admin is successfully created.

You can [edit or delete](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/editing-or-deleting-items-business-insights) admins at any time.
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

---

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/adding-application-tags","lastmod":"2025-07-27T07:06Z","nid":"1526436"} -->
## Adding Application Tags

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/adding-application-tags
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Application Insights > Application Settings > Adding Application Tags
- Last modified: 2025-07-27T07:06Z
- Summary: How to add tag categories and tags in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

To use tags for applications, you must add tag categories and tags for each category. You can add a maximum of 8 tag categories, and each category can consist of 8 tags.

To add a tag category and tags:

1. Go to **Applications**>**Application Settings**>**Tag Management**>**Application Tags**.
2. Click **Create Tag Category**. The **Create New Tag Category** drawer appears.
3. In the **Create New Tag Category**drawer:
  - **Name**: Enter a name for the tag category.
  - **Color**: Select a color to represent the tag category.
  - **Type**: Select **Manual**or **Dynamic**. Manual tagging is individual linking of applications to a tag. Dynamic tagging allows you to configure criteria-based automatic tagging of applications.
    - Manual
    - Dynamic
4. Click **Save**. The tag category is successfully added. You can view the tag category and its tags on the [Application Tags](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-application-tags) page.

- **Name**: Enter the tag name.
- **Applications**: Select the applications that you want to link to this tag.
- Click **Add Tag**to add more tags to the category. Note that only one tag in a category can be linked to an application. See image.

- **Criteria**: Select one of the following criteria based on which the applications are automatically linked to a tag:
  - Engagement Index
  - Active Users
  - ACV
  - Growth Trend
  - Capability
  - Sanction Status
- **Name**: Enter the tag name.
- **Operator**: Select an operator to set the threshold to satisfy the criteria as greater than (**>**), greater than or equal to (**>=**), less than (**<**), less than or equal to (**<=**), equal to (**=**), **Is**, **Is not**, **Contains**, or **Not Contains**.
- **Value**: Enter the value for the selected criteria.

For example, the following GIF shows how to configure a dynamic tag category (Active Users 500) for linking applications that have less than 500 active users to the Low Users tag, and more than or equal to 500 active users to the High Users tag.

See image.

[Image: Dynamic Tags GIF]

[Image: Manual Tag fields in the Add NewTag Category drawer]
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

---

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/adding-contract-tags","lastmod":"2025-07-27T07:06Z","nid":"1526441"} -->
## Adding Contract Tags

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/adding-contract-tags
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Application Insights > Application Settings > Adding Contract Tags
- Last modified: 2025-07-27T07:06Z
- Summary: How to add tag categories and tags in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

To use tags for contracts, you must add tag categories and tags for each category. You can add a maximum of 8 tag categories, and each category can consist of 8 tags.

To add a tag category and tags:

1. Go to **Applications**> **Application Settings**>**Tag Management**>**Contract Tags**.
2. Click **Create Tag Category**. The **Create New Tag Category** drawer appears.
3. In the **Create New Tag Category**drawer:
  - **Name**: Enter a name for the tag category.
  - **Color**: Select a color to represent the tag category.
  - **Type**: Select **Manual**or **Dynamic**. Manual tagging is individual linking of contracts to a tag. Dynamic tagging allows you to configure criteria-based automatic tagging of contracts.
    - Manual
    - Dynamic
4. Click **Save**. The tag category is successfully added. You can view the tag category and its tags on the [Contract Tags](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-contract-tags) page.

- **Name**: Enter the tag name.
- **Contracts**: Select the contracts that you want to link to this tag.
- Click **Add Tag**to add more tags to the category. Note that only one tag in a category can be linked to a contract. See image.

- **Criteria**: Select one of the following criteria based on which the contracts are dynamically linked to a tag:
  - TCV
  - ACV
  - Seller Name
  - Application
  - Vendor
  - License
- **Name**: Enter the tag name.
- **Operator**: Select an operator to set the threshold to satisfy the criteria as greater than (**>**), greater than or equal to (**>=**), less than (**<**), less than or equal to (**<=**), equal to (**=**), **Is**, **Is not**, **Contains**, or **Not Contains**.
- **Value**: Enter the value for the selected criteria.

For example, the following GIF shows how to configure a dynamic tag for linking contracts that have an annual contract value (ACV) of $10K or less to the Low ACV tag, and more than $10K to the High ACV tag.

See image.

[Image: Create New Dynamic Tag Category for Contracts]

[Image: Create New Tag Category Drawer for Contract Tags]
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/adding-exclusion","lastmod":"2025-09-05T01:25Z","nid":"1498276"} -->
## Adding an Exclusion

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/adding-exclusion
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Analytics > Adding an Exclusion
- Last modified: 2025-09-05T01:25Z
- Summary: Information on how to add an exclusion in the Business Insights Admin Portal

Add exclusions to set criteria for excluding users and departments from a scheduled report. You can add multiple exclusions, however you can only enable up to 8 exclusions at any time. If you choose to apply the exclusion list when scheduling a report, the report excludes the users and departments using only the enabled exclusions.

To add an exclusion:

1. Go to **Analytics** > **Reports** > **Application Reports** > **Exclusion List**.
2. Click **Add Exclusion**. A new row is added at the bottom of the exclusion list.
3. In the new columns: The exclusion is successfully added to the exclusion list.
  - **Users**: Select the users that you want to add to the exclusion.
  - **Departments**: Select the departments that you want to add to the exclusion.
  - **Applications**: Select the applications that you want to add to the exclusion. Enabled exclusions are associated with only those scheduled reports where the applications configured in both the scheduled report and the exclusion match.
  - **Enabled**: Select this option to enable the exclusion. You can disable this option at any time.
  - **Action**: Click the checkmarkicon () to add the exclusion, or click the **Close** icon () to cancel the configuration. See image.
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

---

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/adding-saas-application-tenant-workflow-automation","lastmod":"2024-11-13T05:33Z","nid":"1500016"} -->
## Adding a SaaS Application Tenant for Workflow Automation

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/adding-saas-application-tenant-workflow-automation
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Authentication & Administration > Workflow Automation Integration > Adding a SaaS Application Tenant for Workflow Automation
- Last modified: 2024-11-13T05:33Z
- Summary: How to add a SaaS application tenant in Business Insights Admin Portal for Workflow Automation integration.

You can integrate SaaS applications with Workflow Automation for the Business Insights service by adding them as tenants.

To add a SaaS application tenant:

1. Go to **Administration**> **Workflow Integration**.
2. Click **Add SaaS Application Tenant**. The **Add SaaS Application Tenant** page appears.
3. Under **Choose the SaaS Application Provider**, search for or choose from one of the SaaS applications you want to integrate for Workflow Automation. See image.
4. Under **Name the SaaS Application Tenant**, enter a name for the SaaS application tenant. It must be unique.
5. Under **Onboard SaaS Application for**, select **Workflow Automation**. See image.
6. Complete the specific configuration steps for your chosen application:
  - ServiceNow
7. Click **Save**.

[Image: Add SaaS Application Tenant page]

To configure ServiceNow as a tenant, you must have a ServiceNow user account with an admin role.

To configure ServiceNow:

- a. Verify the OAuth 2.0 plugin is active.
- b. Verify the OAuth property is active.
- c. Configure an OAuth client application.
- d. Add ServiceNow as a tenant.

To learn more about the steps in ServiceNow, refer to the [ServiceNow documentation](https://docs.servicenow.com/).

To learn more about adding additional object types for ServiceNow tenants, see [Adding Object Types for ServiceNow Tenants](https://help.zscaler.com/zia/adding-object-types-servicenow-tenants).

To verify the OAuth 2.0 plugin is installed and active:

1. Log in to your ServiceNow instance.
2. Go to **System Application** > **All Available Applications** > **All**. See image.
3. Enter `OAuth 2.0` in the search bar. The OAuth 2.0 plugin appears. Ensure it's **Installed**. See image. If the plugin isn't installed, click **Install** and then **Activate**.

[Image: The All menu under System Applications in the ServiceNow portal.]

[Image: The OAuth 2.0 plugin is installed in ServiceNow.]

To verify that the OAuth property is active:

1. In the **Filter navigator**, enter `sys_properties.list` and press `Enter` on your keyboard. See image.
2. On the **System Properties** page, enter the following property in the search bar and press `Enter` on your keyboard:

```
com.snc.platform.security.oauth.is.active
```

See image.

1. Ensure that the **Value** column for the **com.snc.platform.security.oauth.is.active** property is **true**. See image. If it's not, in the **Name** column, click **com.snc.platform.security.oauth.is.active**, enter `true` for the **Value**, and then click **Update**. See image.

[Image: sys_properties.list entered in the ServiceNow Filter navigator.]

[Image: com.snc.platform.security.oauth.is.active property entered in the search bar on the System Properties page.]

[Image: true highlighted in the Value column for the com.snc.platform.security.oauth.is.active property.]

[Image: The Value field highlighted in the System Property window.]

To configure an OAuth client application:

1. Go to **System OAuth** > **Application Registry**. See image.
2. Click **New**. See image.
3. Click **Create an OAuth API endpoint for external clients**. See image. The **Application Registries New Record** window appears.
4. In the **Application Registries New Record** window: See image.
  - **Name**: Enter a name for the OAuth client application. In this example, it's `Zscaler SaaS Application Tenant`.
  - **Client ID**: Copy the client ID of the application. You need it for a later step.
  - **Client Secret**: The shared secret of the application, which the ServiceNow instance and the OAuth client application use to authorize their communication. The secret generates after you submit this application registry.
  - **Refresh Token Lifespan**: The default lifespan is 8,640,000 seconds (100 days). Zscaler recommends changing it to a larger value, such as 157,700,000 seconds (5 years) because you'll need to configure ServiceNow as a new tenant after the refresh token expires.
  - **Access Token Lifespan**: The default value is 1,800 seconds (30 minutes). Zscaler recommends changing it to a larger value, such as 86,400 seconds (24 hours).
5. Click **Submit**.
6. On the **Application Registries** page, in the **Name** column, click the name of the configured OAuth client application. In this example, it's **Zscaler SaaS Application Tenant**. See image. The **Application Registries** window appears.
7. In the **Application Registries** window, click the **Lock** icon for **Client Secret**. See image.
8. Copy the client secret. You need it for a later step. See image.

[Image: The Application Registry menu in the ServiceNow portal.]

[Image: The New button on the Application Registries page.]

[Image: The Create an OAuth API endpoint for external clients option on the OAuth application page.]

[Image: The configured Application Registries New Record window.]

[Image: The OAuth client application name in the Name column on the Application Registries page.]

[Image: The Lock icon for the Client Secret in the Application Registries window of the OAuth client application.]

[Image: The visible Client Secret on the Application Registries window of the OAuth client application.]

To add ServiceNow as a SaaS application tenant:

1. Under **Register the OAuth Application**: See image.
  - **Client ID**: Enter the client ID that you previously copied.
  - **Client Secret**: Enter the Client Secret that you previously copied.
  - **Instance URL**: Enter the URL used to log in to your ServiceNow instance.
  - **User ID**: Enter the user ID of the user account used to configure the OAuth client application.
  - **User Password**: Enter the password of the user account used to configure the OAuth client application.
2. Under **Enter the ServiceNow Admin Email ID**, enter the admin email ID used to log in to your ServiceNow instance. See image.
3. Under **Authorize the SaaS Application**, click **Authorize**. See image.

[Image: The Register the OAuth Application section on the Add SaaS Application Tenant page.]

[Image: The ServiceNow Admin Email ID field in the Enter the ServiceNow Admin Email ID section.]

[Image: The Authorize button in the Authorize the SaaS Application section.]

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/adding-workplace-tags","lastmod":"2025-06-12T23:36Z","nid":"1510611"} -->
## Adding Workplace Tags

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/adding-workplace-tags
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Workplace Insights > Workplace Settings > Adding Workplace Tags
- Last modified: 2025-06-12T23:36Z
- Summary: How to add workplace tags in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

You can add tag categories and tags in each category, which can be used to link to workplaces. You can add a maximum of 8 tag categories, and each category can consist of 8 tags.

To add a tag category and tags:

1. Go to **Workplaces**> **Offices and Locations**> click the drop-down menu under the Tags column for any office >**Manage All Tags**,or**Workplace Settings**> **Configured Offices**> click the Tags filter> **Manage All Tags**.
2. Click **Create Tag Category**. The **Create New Tag Category** drawer appears.
3. In the **Create New Tag Category**drawer:
  - **Name**: Enter a name for the tag category.
  - **Color**: Select a color to represent the tag category.
  - **Type**: Select **Manual**or **Dynamic**. Manual tagging is individual linking of workplaces to a tag. Dynamic tagging allows you to configure criteria-based automatic tagging of workplaces.
    - Manual
    - Dynamic
4. Click **Save**. The tag category is successfully added. You can view the tag category and its tags on the [Tag Management](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-tags) page.

- **Name**: Enter the tag name.
- **Offices**: Select the offices that you want to link to this tag.
- Click **Add Tag**to add more tags to the category. Note that only one tag in a category can be linked to an office. See image.

- **Criteria**: Select one of the following criteria based on which the offices are automatically linked to a tag:
  - Assigned Headcounts
  - Capacity
  - Hotel Desks
  - Lease End Date
  - Lease Status
  - Permanent Desks
- **Name**: Enter the tag name.
- **Operator**: Select an operator to set the threshold to satisfy the criteria as greater than (**>**), greater than or equal to (**>=**), less than (**<**), less than or equal to (**<=**), equal to (**=**), **Contains**, or **Not Contains**.
- **Value**: Enter the value for the selected criteria.

For example, the following GIF shows how to configure a dynamic tag for linking offices that have a capacity of 500 or less to the High Cap tag and more than 500 to the Low Cap tag.

See image.

[Image: Dynamic Tags GIF]

[Image: Manual Tag fields in the Add NewTag Category drawer]

## Analyzing a Workplace

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/analyzing-workplace
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Workplace Insights > Analyzing a Workplace
- Last modified: 2025-06-18T09:07Z
- Summary: Information about a workplace in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

The Workplace Details page shows various metrics such as occupancy, attendance, and footfall details for a workplace. To view the insights for a workplace, go to the Offices and Locations page (Workplace > Offices and Locations) and click on a workplace name, or go to the Workplace Insights page (Workplace > Workplace Insights) and click **View Details** for the workplace you want to view.

To analyze the Workplace Details page:

- **Export as PDF**: Download the data on the page as a PDF file.
- **Time Range**: View workplace details for the last 7 days, a week, a month, or 3 months, then choose the week, month, or 3 months from the right pane. The data aggregation for the custom week, month, or quarter might take some time to process. See image.
- Filter the insights by:
  - **Departments**or**Divisions**: The department filter is available unless you have at least one department mapping to a division on the [Department Mapping](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-department-mapping) page.
    - **Departments**: The departments within your organization. This data is mapped from the ZIA Admin Portal SCIM. If the values are inaccurate, contact a ZIA admin.
    - **Divisions**: The division that maps related departments.
  - **Days**: Specific days from the filtered time frame. Enable **Custom Dates**to select custom dates to include or exclude from the insights. By default, Saturdays and Sundays are excluded from the metrics. See image.
  - **User Types**: The type of users or employees visiting your organization. Selecting **User Types** doesn't filter the data unless you have defined user types for your organization in Business Insights. To enable this filter, contact Zscaler Support.

The page contains the following information:

## Averages Section

This section contains the following widgets:

- **Average Occupancy**: The average occupancy in percentage for the workplace within the specified time frame. This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the workplace capacity for the time period specified, then multiplying it by 100. You can view the total number of visits vs. the total possible capacity. The total possible capacity is determined by multiplying the workplace capacity by the number of official working days within the time frame selected. For example, if your capacity is 100 and there are 5 official working days, the possible capacity is 500. You can also view the percentage increase or decrease in occupancy vs. the previous period of the same time (e.g., Month over Month (MoM), Week over Week (WoW), or Quarter over Quarter (QoQ)).
- **Peak / Low Occupancy**: The peak and low occupancy percentage on a particular day and the number of office visits for the workplace within the specified time frame.
- **Average Attendance**: The average attendance for the workplace within the specified time frame. This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the total number of assigned headcount for the workplace, then multiplying it by 100. You can view the total number of visits vs. the total possible assigned headcount. The total possible assigned headcount is determined by multiplying the workplace capacity by the number of official working days within the time frame selected. For example, if your capacity is 100 and there are 5 official working days, the possible assigned headcount is 500. You can also view the percentage increase or decrease in attendance vs. the previous period of the same time (e.g., Month over Month (MoM), Week over Week (WoW), or Quarter over Quarter (QoQ)).
- **Average Visit Span**: The average time spent in the workplace.

The metrics are calculated considering a 5-day work week.

See image.

The metrics for inferred location-based workplaces are estimated as the Business Insights service doesn't have precise metadata to provide accurate insight. Hence, Zscaler recommends configuring offices (providing metadata) for inferred location-based workplaces to view accurate insights.
See image.

## Occupancy Tab

This tab consists of the following sections:

The explanatory sentence at the top of sections is shown for the filtered time frame and not for the time frames it is compared with.

### Occupancy by Day

The graph shows the occupancy comparison trend for the time frame specified. For example, if you filter the data for the current week, this graph shows the occupancy comparison with last week's data. You can:

- View the data in the graph in percentage or numerical values by selecting the respective options (i.e., **Percentage** or **Value**).
- View the data for a specific time frame by selecting the checkboxes next to the graph (e.g., last week or current week).
- View the average occupancy for the office within the specified time frame, as well as the occupancy goal percentage (and the numerical value) configured for the office.
- Hover over a date in the graph to view the percentage increase or decrease in the occupancy and the average occupancy.

### Occupancy by Day of the Week

This graph shows the occupancy percentage for each day of the week. This is calculated by dividing the number of users who came into the workplace on that day by the capacity of the workplace, then multiplying it by 100. You can:

- View the data in the graph in percentage or numerical values by selecting the respective options (i.e., **Percentage** or **Value**).
- View the data for a specific time frame by selecting the checkboxes at the bottom of the graph (e.g., last week vs. current week).

### Footfall by the Time of the Day

This section shows the hourly footfall information for the workplace for the filtered time frame averaged for 7 days of the week if you select to view monthly data. Hover over an hour bar to view the day and date information, and the total number of employees present in the workplace during that hour, followed by the split between departments.

In this section, you can:

- Click the **Export**button to download the footfall data as a CSV file. This option is available when the **Time Range** filter at the top of the page is selected as **Last 7 days** or **Week**. See image.
- Click an hour bar to view the total user footfall for each department. See image.
- Select to view the footfall data for any 1 of the 3 months in this section if the **Time Range** filter at the top of the page is selected for 3 months. See image.

See image.

## Attendance Tab

This tab consists of the following sections:

The explanatory sentence at the top of sections is shown for the filtered time frame and not for the time frames it is compared with.

### Attendance by Day

The graph shows the attendance comparison trend for the time frame specified. For example, if you filtered the data for the current week, this graph shows the attendance percentage comparison with last week's data. You can:

- View the data in the graph in percentage, numerical values, or days per week by selecting the respective options (i.e., **Percentage**, **Value**, or **Days per Week**).
- View the data for a specific time frame by selecting the checkboxes next to the graph (e.g., last week vs. current week).
- View the average attendance for the office within the specified time frame, as well as the attendance goal percentage (and the numerical value) configured for the office.
- Hover over a date in the graph to view the percentage increase or decrease in attendance and the average attendance.

### Attendance by Day of the Week

This graph shows the attendance percentage for each day of the week. This is calculated by dividing the number of users who came to the workplace on that day by the total number of users assigned to the workplace, then multiplying it by 100. You can:

- View the data in the graph in percentage or numerical values by selecting the respective options (i.e., **Percentage** or **Value**).
- View the data for a specific time frame by selecting the checkboxes at the bottom of the graph (e.g., last week vs. current week).

### Attendance by Days per Week

The pie chart shows the percentage of users (and their count) who came into the workplace less than a day to 7 days a week. The center of the pie chart shows the total number of users.

### Attendance by Department

The bar chart shows the percentage of users coming into the workplace from the total number of users assigned to the workplace and the expected attendance for each department at the workplace. Select the **Show Unassigned Users** checkbox to view the data for users that are not assigned to a department.

See image.

[Image: Estimated Averages section showing various workplace-related numbers]

[Image: Averages Section showing various workplace-related numbers]

[Image: Export option in Footfall by the Time of the Day section]

[Image: User count for each department]

[Image: Footfall Section Filter for 3 Months]

[Image: Occupancy Tab for Workplace]

[Image: Attendance tab showing attendance data for the workplace]

[Image: The Days filter for analyzing a workplace]

[Image: Time Range Filter]

## Analyzing Workplace Insights

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/analyzing-workplace-insights
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Workplace Insights > Analyzing Workplace Insights
- Last modified: 2025-06-13T00:24Z
- Summary: Information about the Workplace Insights page in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

Workplace Insights provides metrics related to workplaces and their workforces across the globe for an organization. This information can be used to view actionable insights and efficiently manage your workplaces. There are two types of workplaces: inferred locations and configured offices.

- Inferred Locations are [Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) locations](https://help.zscaler.com/zia/about-locations) configured in the ZIA Admin Portal (a ZIA location can also consist of sub-locations) and inferred IP addresses that the Business Insights service concludes as the organization's workplace based on the amount of traffic, the number of users behind the IP address, and more assuring metrics.
- Configured Offices are the grouping of inferred locations into a configured office with metadata. To learn more, see [About Configured Offices](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-configured-offices).

Workplace Insights provides the following benefits and enables you to:

- View the organization's workforce locations and their insights.
- Manage your workplace more effectively.
- Make business-critical decisions, like opening, shutting down, and optimizing offices.

See image.

Zscaler recommends configuring offices (providing metadata) for inferred location-based workplaces to get accurate insights. After you update office metadata, it is reflected in Workplace Insights after the daily service scan.

## Analyzing Workplace Insights

To analyze the Workplace Insights page (Workplace > Workplace Insights), use the following operators to filter the data for your viewing requirements:

- **Export as PDF**: Download the data on the page as a PDF file.
- **Time Range**: View workplace insights for the last 7 days, a week, a month, or 3 months, then choose the week, month, or 3 months from the right pane. The data aggregation for the custom week, month, or quarter might take some time to process. See image.
- Filter insights by:
  - **Type**: The type of workplace (**Offices** or **Inferred Locations**). For **Geolocation**, select the workplaces based on the type selected. Business Insights automatically assigns names for inferred location workplaces that are based on IP addresses and retains the name assigned in the ZIA Admin Portal for [ZIA location](https://help.zscaler.com/zia/about-locations)-based workplaces. You can only select to view data for either the configured offices or inferred locations at one time.
  - **Days**: Specific days from the filtered time frame. Enable **Custom Dates** to select custom dates to include or exclude from the insights. By default, Saturdays and Sundays are excluded from the metrics. See image.
  - **Departments**or**Divisions**: The department filter is available unless you have at least one department mapping to a division on the [Department Mapping](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-department-mapping) page.
    - **Departments**: The departments within your organization. This data is mapped from the ZIA Admin Portal SCIM. If the values are inaccurate, contact a ZIA admin.
    - **Divisions**: The division that maps related departments.
  - **User Types**: The type of users visiting your organization. Selecting user types doesn't filter the data unless you have defined these user types for your organization in Business Insights. To enable this filter, contact Zscaler Support.

See image.

The page contains the following sections:

### Overall Averages

This section contains the following widgets:

- **Average Occupancy**: The average occupancy in percentage and numbers for the filtered offices within the specified time frame. This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplaces by overall workplace capacities for the time period specified, then multiplying it by 100. You can view the total number of visits vs. the total possible capacity. The total possible capacity is determined by multiplying the capacity for all selected offices by the number of official working days within the time frame selected. For example, if your capacity is 100 and there are 5 official working days, the possible capacity is 500. You can also view the percentage increase or decrease in occupancy vs. the previous period of the same time (e.g., Month over Month (MoM), Week over Week (WoW), or Quarter over Quarter (QoQ)).
- **Peak / Low Occupancy**: The peak and low occupancy percentage on a particular day and the number of office visits for the filtered workplaces within the specified time frame.
- **Average Attendance**: The average attendance for the workplaces within the specified time frame. This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplaces by the total number of assigned headcount for the workplaces, then multiplying it by 100. You can view the total number of visits vs. the total possible assigned headcount. The total possible assigned headcount is determined by multiplying the capacity for all selected offices by the number of official working days within the time frame selected. For example, if your capacity is 100 and there are 5 official working days, the possible assigned headcount is 500. You can also view the percentage increase or decrease in attendance vs. the previous period of the same time (e.g., Month over Month (MoM), Week over Week (WoW), or Quarter over Quarter (QoQ)).
- **Average Visit Span**: The average time spent in the offices.

You can only view data for either the configured offices or inferred locations at one time. The metrics are calculated considering a 5-day work week.

See image.

If you've filtered the data for inferred offices, the data in this section are estimated as the Business Insights service doesn't have precise metadata to provide accurate insight. Click **Upload data to view insights** and provide metadata to view accurate insights. You're redirected to the [Configured Offices](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-configured-offices) page.

See image.

### Attendance by Days per Week

This graph shows the attendance percentage (and the actual numbers) for each day of the week. This is calculated by dividing the number of visits to the workplace on that day by the total number of headcount assigned to the workplace.

See image.

### Top Cities

This section shows the top cities by the number of employees and the frequency of their office visits (remote, less than or equal to 2 days a week, more than 2 days a week). Hover over a bar to view the number of employees at each frequency indicated by a unique color. You can also download the data to a CSV file by clicking the **Export**() icon.

See image.

### Top Offices

Switch between **Least Used** and **Most Used** to view the workplaces with least and most occupancy and attendance, respectively. For each workplace widget, you can see:

- The name of the workplace.
- The city, state or province, and country where the workplace is located.
- The type of workplace whether a configured office or inferred location.
- **Average Attendance**: The average attendance for the workplace for the filtered time frame.
- **Average Occupancy**: The average occupancy for the workplaces within the filtered time frame.
- **See Details**: Click to view additional details for the workplace. To learn more, see [Analyzing a Workplace](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/analyzing-workplace).

Click **View All** to see all the workplaces on the [Offices and Locations](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-offices-and-locations) Page.

See image.

### Map View

Switch between **Geography** and **Remote User Density** to view the following insights:

- Geography
- Remote User Density

See image.

To understand the terms used in Business Insights, see [Understanding Business Insights Terminology](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/understanding-business-insights-terminology).

View the distribution of workplaces across the globe. You can zoom in and out using your mouse or the icons at the bottom-right corner. Click a workplace to view:

- The name of the workplace.
- The city, state or province, and country where the workplace is located.
- The type of workplace, whether a configured office or inferred location.
- **Average Attendance**: The average attendance for the workplace for the filtered time frame.
- **Average Occupancy**: The average occupancy for the workplace for the filtered time frame.
- **See Details**: Click to view additional details for the workplace. To learn more, see [Analyzing a Workplace](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/analyzing-workplace).

If you don't see a configured office on the map, metadata for that office is missing. Make sure you specify the city, state or province, and country information when configuring offices to locate the configured office on the map.

You can only select to view data for either the configured offices or inferred locations at one time.

View locations across the globe for remote users. Zoom in and out using your mouse or the icons at the bottom-right corner. You can view:

- The total number of remote users across the globe.
- **Potential Sites Opportunities**: A list of cities with the number and percentage of remote users where you can consider opening an office.
- The total number of remote users working from the country by hovering over a country.
- Countries with darker gray signifying more remote users compared to lighter-shaded countries with fewer remote users.
- Workplaces that show the following information when you hover over them: Click on the workplace to view additional details. To learn more, see [Analyzing a Workplace](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/analyzing-workplace).
  - The name of the workplace.
  - The city, state or province, and country where the workplace is located.
  - The type of workplace, whether a configured office or inferred location.
  - **Average Attendance**: The average attendance for the workplace for the filtered time frame.
  - **Average Occupancy**: The average occupancy for the workplace for the filtered time frame.

[Image: Workplace Insights Page]

[Image: Fitlering Options for the Workplace Insights]

[Image: Days Filter]

[Image: Time Range Filter]

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/business-insights-admins","lastmod":"2025-06-16T23:28Z","nid":"1514366"} -->
## Business Insights for Admins

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/business-insights-admins
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Getting Started > Admin Portal > Business Insights for Admins
- Last modified: 2025-06-16T23:28Z
- Summary: Information on how to make the best use of all available features in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

This article explains how to leverage various features available in the Business Insights Admin Portal to view accurate and rich applications and workplace insights. Business Insights is divided into two categories—applications and workplace—and also includes reports and administration management to manage your admins. To learn more, see [What Is Zscaler Business Insights?](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/what-zscaler-business-insights) and [Understanding Business Insights Architecture.](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/understanding-business-insights-architecture)

## Applications

To view your organization's SaaS application and its contract insights to make business-critical decisions like offloading applications, reducing licenses, and switching to more cost-effective alternatives, consider configuring the following features:

- To view accurate application insights about their usage, active and inactive users, and costs—among many other vital metrics—consider configuring sanctioned applications to pull usage information and view insights. Zscaler recommends configuring a SaaS application connector (requires admin access to the app) for the supported apps, or creating custom application signatures to pull metrics from a specific URL of the application per your requirements. To learn more, see [About Application Configuration](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-application-configuration).
- While configuring applications helps in viewing accurate insights, uploading application contracts with all your vendors helps in managing and viewing annual contract value (ACV), total contract value (TCV), SaaS spending, deadlines, and licensing models. To learn more, see [About Contracts](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-contracts).
- Tags for linking applications and contracts to user-defined tags. Tagging is leveraged as a filtering option for viewing insights. To learn more, see [About Application Tags](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-application-tags) and [About Contract Tags](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-contract-tags).

After configuring the preceding features, refer to the following articles to view and analyze application insights in the Business Insights Admin Portal:

- [About Application Insights](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-application-insights)
- [About All Applications](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-all-applications)
- [Viewing Application Overlap Details](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/viewing-application-overlap-details)
- [Viewing Application Details](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/viewing-application-details)

## Workplace

To view your organization's workplace insights to manage your workforce and workplace more effectively, and also make business-critical decisions like opening, shutting down, and optimizing offices, consider configuring the following features:

- Offices for all your workplaces that are being used by your organization to efficiently track and manage the workforce and workplaces. To learn more, see [About Configured Offices](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-configured-offices).
- Organization and office-level attendance goals to gauge workplace attendance against the defined goals. To learn more, see [Configuring Organization-Level Occupancy & Attendance Goals](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-organization-level-occupancy-attendance-goals) and [Configuring Occupancy & Attendance Goals for an Office](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-occupancy-attendance-goals-office).
- Department Mapping to categorize multiple departments into a division to filter and view workplace insights for specific divisions. To learn more, see [About Department Mapping](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-department-mapping).
- Tags for linking offices to user-defined tags. Tagging is leveraged as a filtering option for viewing insights for workplaces. To learn more, see [About Workplace Tags](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-tag-management).

After configuring the preceding features, refer to the following articles to view and analyze workplace insights:

- [Analyzing Workplace Insights](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/analyzing-workplace-insights)
- [About Offices and Locations](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-offices-and-locations)
- [Viewing Offices and Locations on a Map](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/viewing-offices-and-locations-map)
- [Viewing Offices and Locations in a Chart](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/viewing-offices-and-locations-chart)
- [Analyzing a Workplace](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/analyzing-workplace)

## Reports

You can download system-generated reports and also schedule applications and workplace reports. To learn more, see [Downloading Business Insights Reports](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/downloading-business-insights-reports), [About Application Reports](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-application-reports), and [About Workplace Reports](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-workplace-reports).

## Administration Management

To effectively manage admins in the Business Insights Admin Portal, configure the following features:

- Role-Based Administration to delegate different types of admins to the Business Insights Admin Portal. To learn more, see [Configuring Role-Based Administration](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-role-based-administration-business-insights).
- Administrator Management Settings to define parameters for admins' password, SAML authentication, and SCIM. To learn more, see [Understanding Administrator Management Settings](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/understanding-administrator-management-settings-business-insights).
- [SAML single sign-on (SSO)](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-saml-admins-business-insights) based on the IdP of your choice:
  - [SAML Configuration Guide for Microsoft Entra ID](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/saml-configuration-guide-microsoft-entra-id)
  - [SAML Configuration Guide for Okta](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/saml-configuration-guide-okta)
- Workflow Automation to manage users' application provisioning status based on their various usage criteria defined in [Scheduled Reports](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/scheduling-reports).

Apart from configuring these features, you can view the following information that is pulled from your organization's Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) traffic:

- [About ZIA Users](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-zia-users)
- [About Departments](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-departments)

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/configuring-advanced-configuration-admins","lastmod":"2024-11-13T05:29Z","nid":"1473151"} -->
## Configuring Advanced Configuration for Admins

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-advanced-configuration-admins
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Authentication & Administration > Administrator and Role Management > Configuring Advanced Configuration for Admins
- Last modified: 2024-11-13T05:29Z
- Summary: How to configure advanced configuration for admins in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

Every Business Insights admin has a *user account.*You can configure the action to be taken against the admin accounts when an admin's user account is deleted using SCIM.

Actions on admins through SCIM are reflected in the Business Insights Admin Portal. For example, disabling an admin's user account through SCIM disables both the admin and its linked user account in the Business Insights Admin Portal. Configuring the action for deleted users only affects deleted users, and does not affect disabled users.

If you are subscribed to the Authentication Service service, the Administrator Management page shows a link to the Authentication Service Admin Portal. You can manage your admins from the [Authentication Service Admin Portal](https://help.zscaler.com/zidentity/accessing-and-navigating-zidentity-admin-portal). To learn more, see [What Is Authentication Service?](https://help.zscaler.com/zidentity/what-zidentity)
See image.

To configure advanced configuration for admins:

1. Go to **Administration** > **Administrator Management**.
2. Click the **Administrator Management** tab.
3. On the **Administrator Management** page, in the **Advanced Configuration** section, choose one of the following options from the **Admin Account** **Action When SCIM Deletes Linked User Account**drop-down menu:

- Select**Delete** if you want to allow SCIM to delete the admin and its linked user account.
- Select**Do Nothing** if you do not want to allow SCIM to delete the admin and its linked user account. SCIM will return error 409 (Admin user cannot be deleted). **Do Nothing** is the default.

See image.

1. Click **Save**.
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/configuring-data-explorer-views","lastmod":"2025-10-25T07:06Z","nid":"1529732"} -->
## Configuring Data Explorer Views

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-data-explorer-views
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Analytics > Configuring Data Explorer Views
- Last modified: 2025-10-25T07:06Z
- Summary: How to configure Data Explorer views in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

Data Explorer provides the flexibility to build and organize your own customized views of metrics to analyze data.

To configure a view:

1. Go to **Analytics**> **Data Explorer**. The **Data Explorer** page appears. See image. You can select from existing templates and modify them as necessary, or you can create your own view.
2. In the **Metrics** section, select the metrics for the view. You can select multiple metrics:
  - Bytes
  - Visits
  - Occupancy
  - Attendance
3. In the **Operations** section, structure the view using the following operators:
  - a. Group By
  - b. Aggregation
  - c. Aggregation Type
4. In the **Filters** section, click **Add** to narrow the results of your view for a specific **Division**, **Department**, and **Work Mode**.
5. In the **Chart Type** section, select a chart type icon to display data in a specific chart or tabular format.
6. In the **Time Period** section, select an option to process the data for the **Last 7 days**, **Week**, **Month**, or **3 Months**.
7. Click **Run Query** to display your customized view in the right pane. See image. You can click **Reset** to configure another view.

You can analyze the data using the following options:

1. Click **Export Full Report** to download a detailed report.
2. Click **Export**to download the data as a CSV file.
3. Click **Save and Schedule** to schedule a report based on the applied filter. You can schedule Data Explorer reports only when the time period selected is **Last Day**, **Last Week**, or **Last Month**. To learn more, see [Scheduling Data Explorer Reports](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/scheduling-data-explorer-reports).
4. Search for a specific metric to select or deselect it from the view.
5. Select or deselect metrics from the chart view. See image.

Select an option to group data by:

- Department
- Division
- Office
- Work Mode
- Geolocation
- User

Select the data aggregation:

- Daily
- Weekly
- Monthly

Select the data aggregation function:

- Sum
- Maximum
- Minimum
- Average

This option is not available for daily aggregation.

[Image: Configuring Data Explorer views using templates]

[Image: Configuring Data Explorer Views for analysis]

[Image: Data Explorer view showing various options]
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/configuring-occupancy-attendance-goals-office","lastmod":"2024-10-14T07:06Z","nid":"1503821"} -->
## Configuring Occupancy & Attendance Goals for an Office

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-occupancy-attendance-goals-office
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Workplace Insights > Workplace Settings > Configuring Occupancy & Attendance Goals for an Office
- Last modified: 2024-10-14T07:06Z
- Summary: Information on configuring occupancy and attendance goals for an office in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

You can configure occupancy and attendance goals for an office to track metrics against the configured goals and take necessary actions to achieve them.

To configure occupancy and attendance goals for an office:

1. Go to **Workplace** > **Workplace Settings**.
2. Locate the office for which you want to configure goals, and click the **Edit** icon. The **Edit Office** drawer appears.
3. In the **Edit** **Office** drawer: See image.
  - **Occupancy Goal Percentage**: Enter the occupancy goal between 1 and 100. For example, if you set the occupancy to 30, the office is expected to be occupied by at least 30% of its assigned users.
  - **Attendance Goal Percentage**: Enter the attendance goal (i.e., 20, 40, 60, 80, or 100 for 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 days per week, respectively). For example, if the attendance goal is set to 40, the users assigned to the office are expected to come into the office at least 2 days per week.
4. Click **Save**.

[Image: Edit Office drawer]
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/configuring-office","lastmod":"2025-04-01T00:37Z","nid":"1490951"} -->
## Configuring an Office

- Source: https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-office
- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Workplace Insights > Workplace Settings > Configuring an Office
- Last modified: 2025-04-01T00:37Z
- Summary: Information on how to configure an office in the Business Insights Admin Portal.

Configuring offices for your organization helps you group various [Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) locations](https://help.zscaler.com/zia/about-locations), inferred IP addresses, and new IP addresses to specific office locations. These configured offices are listed and managed on the [Offices](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-offices) page. This helps to generate more accurate workplace insights by consolidating office traffic to the respective offices.

To configure an office:

1. Go to **Workplace** > **Offices and Locations**> **Discovered Locations** or **Offices**.
2. Click **Add Office**. The **Add Office** drawer appears.
3. In the **Add Office** drawer:
  - **Office Name**: Enter a name for the office.
  - **Add Locations or IP Addresses**: Select the ZIA locations and sublocations that you want to associate with this office. Any new location added to the ZIA Admin Portal is reflected in this field after one day. You can also enter the IP addresses associated with the office. You can enter multiple IP addresses using commas to separate each IP address.
  - **Building ID**: Enter a unique building ID for the office building.
  - **Address**: Enter the address of the office location. The address autopopulates in the drop-down menu.
  - **Capacity**: Enter the number of employees the office can accommodate. This value helps calculate the occupancy of the office.
  - **Assigned Headcount**: Enter the number of users that you want to assign to the office. This value helps calculate the attendance metrics for the office.
  - **Site ID**: Enter the site ID assigned to the office.
  - **Size in Sq Ft**: Enter the size of the office in square feet.
  - **Permanent Desks**: Enter the number of permanent desks in the office.
  - **Hotel Desks**: Enter the number of hotel desks available in the office.
  - **Lease Status**: Specify the office building lease status (leased, owned, etc.).
  - **Lease End Date**: Select the date when the office building lease ends, if applicable.
  - **Notes**: Add additional notes for the office.
  - **Occupancy Goal Percentage**: Enter the occupancy goal. For example, if you set the occupancy to 30, the office is expected to be occupied by at least 30% of its assigned users.
  - **Attendance Goal Percentage**: Enter the attendance goal (i.e., 20, 40, 60, 80, or 100 for 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 days per week, respectively). For example, if the attendance goal is set to 40, the users assigned to the office are expected to come into the office at least 2 days per week.
  - **Tags**: Select the tags that you want to link to this office. You can only manually link a maximum of 8 tags. To learn more, see [About Tag Management](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-tag-management). See image.
4. Click **Save**to configure the office. You can also click **Save and Add Another** to configure another office. The office is successfully configured. The newly configured office is listed on the [Offices](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/about-offices) page. The Business Insights service starts aggregating data for the associated ZIA locations, sublocations, and IP addresses under this office. If you delete the office, the Business Insights service stops data aggregation for the office and initiates the display of metrics for each ZIA location, sublocation, and IP address individually in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
<!-- /ZS-ARTICLE -->

---

<!-- ZS-ARTICLE {"url":"/business-insights/configuring-organization-level-occupancy-attendance-goals","lastmod":"2024-09-17T03:12Z","nid":"1500671"} -->
## Configuring Organization-Level Occupancy & Attendance Goals

- Product: Business Insights
- Path: Business Insights Help > Workplace Insights > Workplace Settings > Configuring Organization-Level Occupancy & Attendance Goals
- Last modified: 2024-09-17T03:12Z
- Summary: Information about configuring organization-level occupancy and attendance goals in Business Insights Admin Portal.

You can set organization-level occupancy and attendance goals to track metrics against the configured goals and take necessary actions to achieve them. Individual office goals can be configured in the respective office's Edit Office drawers. To learn more, see [Configuring Occupancy & Attendance Goals for an Office](https://help.zscaler.com/business-insights/configuring-occupancy-attendance-goals-office).

To configure organization-level goals:

1. Go to **Workplace** > **Workplace Settings**.
2. Click the **Occupancy and Attendance Goals**tab.
3. In the **Occupancy Goal Percentage**field, enter the occupancy goal between 1 and 100 (e.g., if the occupancy goal is set to 60, the offices are expected to be occupied by at least 60% of their assigned users).
4. In the **Attendance** **Goal** **Percentage** field, enter the attendance goal (i.e., 20, 40, 60, 80, or 100 for 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 days per week, respectively). For example, if the attendance goal is set to 40, the users are expected to come into the office at least 2 days per week. See image.
5. Click **Save**.
